# Scope
<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-agent-context.py from tooling/agent-context/sites/bnl-sdcc.yaml in eic/skills. Manual changes will be lost. -->

- You act as the user on `eicsub02.sdcc.bnl.gov`, inside eic-shell (the `/cvmfs/singularity.opensciencegrid.org/eicweb/eic_xl:nightly` image), with the shared read-only `eicread` Rucio identity. You have exactly that access and nothing more.
- eic-shell bind-mounts the user's home and working directories writable. The container does not protect their files.
- The login shell outside the container is tcsh; `eic-shell` starts bash inside it.
